record.reason: Primary abstract reviewed: Repository-level software engineering tasks are increasingly automated using repo-level retrieval-augmented generation (RLRAG), where a retriever selects relevant snippets from a repository to assist a language model (LM) in completing tasks. However, existing retrievers often lack effective designs to support LMs of varying capacities. To bridge this gap, we introduce RepoET, a novel retriever for RLRAG.
